method: Terms second read: re-read the Classic 60 EMA fact sheet page (pacificlight.com.sg/support/factsheet-detail/10-classic-60-20-aug-2026, fetched again 2 Nov), both the plan-description line on the waiver and the Early Termination Charge box, and wrote the wording independently. The PacificLight residential T&Cs (notices-terms/terms-conditions, clause 13.2) say termination charges are 'as stipulated in the initial pages of the contract', i.e. the fact sheet, so no other official page restates them.

sources.what: Residential T&Cs clause 13.2 (defers to the contract's initial pages)

terms.etf: No charge if you close your account with no unpaid bills. If a charge applies it depends on your home: S$160 (HDB 1-2 room), S$220 (HDB 3 room), S$320 (HDB 4 room), S$380 (HDB 5 room), S$460 (HDB Executive, Jumbo or Multi-Gen), S$480 (condo, apartment or shophouse), S$720 (terrace), S$1,000 (semi-detached), S$2,000 (bungalow or penthouse).
